content.title: Real Space Discovery
content.subtitle: Apollo 11 Landing Panorama
content.description: Neil Armstrong photographed this view from the Eagle lunar module shortly after Apollo 11 landed. The panorama records the Moon’s Sea of Tranquility.
content.sourceLabel: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
content.sourceCredit: Image credit: Neil Armstrong · Apollo 11 · NASA
content.learningPrompt: What clues show that this picture was taken from a spacecraft?
scienceSteps: OBSERVE — Find the spacecraft, shadows and crater edges.
INFER — Which direction does the sunlight come from?
CHECK — What could give this Moon landscape a sense of scale?
content.creatureComment: A person stood inside that little spacecraft and looked out at another world!
